note: Sole policy input for estate/collect_automation_estate.py. Criterion predicates are implemented as pure functions keyed by criterion id in the collector; this file carries the prompts, weights, evidence requirements, curated goal/consumer mappings, vendor carve-outs, and the canonical two-owner precedence (`owner_table`: every job has a trigger owner and an operation owner). Unknown is never scored as zero.

categories.revenue_impact: Does this job move the 90-day ladder (3 paid deals / 10 qualified calls / 4 offer paths)?
categories.goal_alignment: Does this job serve the signed direction in JAKE_DIRECTION.md and the TELOS gap lines?
categories.operational_necessity: Is this job actually needed, running, owned, and coherent on its authority?
categories.platform_fit: Does the current platform match the canonical framework precedence with evidence?

criteria.prompt: Is a named consumer of this job's output evidenced (person, system, or owner contract)?
criteria.evidence: consumer_map entry citing signed goal evidence, authority owner field, or vendor owner map; keyword similarity alone does not count.

criteria.prompt: Is a named mechanism from this job to the 90-day revenue ladder recorded with a goal citation?
criteria.evidence: consumer_map entry with mechanism + citation of JAKE_DIRECTION/TELOS; keyword match alone earns nothing.

criteria.prompt: For revenue-bearing jobs: did the most recent observed execution succeed?
criteria.evidence: last_status/recentActions/last exit from the owning authority; only answered for jobs with a consumer_map revenue hit.

criteria.prompt: Does the job read or write a named revenue artifact (outreach, CRM, applypilot, postiz, publish paths)?
criteria.evidence: script/workdir/command path matches the revenue_artifact_paths allowlist.

criteria.prompt: Is the job's effect target unique across the estate (no duplicate sibling on any scheduler)?
criteria.evidence: normalized command/workflow target + schedule + effect target; curated effect_groups plus mechanical identical-command detection.

criteria.prompt: Does the job map to the RIG destination or an offer path with a cited mechanism?
criteria.evidence: consumer_map goal_keys include rig_destination/paid_deals/qualified_calls/offer_paths with citation.

criteria.prompt: Does the job map to the fitness floor (training block, bodybuilding) with a cited mechanism?
criteria.evidence: consumer_map entry with goal_key fitness and mechanism; none expected in the current estate — proposals carry the gap.

criteria.prompt: Does the job map to the James-affirmation floor with a cited mechanism?
criteria.evidence: consumer_map entry with goal_key james_affirmation and mechanism.

criteria.prompt: Does the job map to the learning/knowledge floor with a cited mechanism?
criteria.evidence: consumer_map entry with goal_key learning and mechanism (e.g. corpus substrate feeding TELOS gap 4).

criteria.prompt: Is the job output reviewed by a human or downstream verifier channel?
criteria.evidence: deliver channel (telegram/origin/all = 0.5 delivered, readback unproven; 1 only with named verifier in consumer_map); local-only remains UNKNOWN.

criteria.prompt: Is a maintainer or owner named on the authority?
criteria.evidence: vendor owner map (0.5, installer-owned), consumer_map owner (1), platform service label only (0.5), nothing (UNKNOWN).

criteria.prompt: Is a schedule or trigger actually configured on the authority?
criteria.evidence: StartCalendarInterval/StartInterval/WatchPaths/Sockets (launchd), schedule.expr (hermes), rrule (orca), structuredCalendar (temporal), triggers in sourceCode (kestra).

criteria.prompt: Was there an execution (attempt or run) recorded within the last 7 days?
criteria.evidence: last_run_at / lastRunAt / recentActions timestamps; authorities without run-result timestamps stay UNKNOWN.

criteria.prompt: Is the last observed result free of failure?
criteria.evidence: hermes last_status, launchctl last exit code, temporal recentActions status; no result evidence stays UNKNOWN.

criteria.prompt: Is the authority state coherent (installed record parses, label joined against loaded state, latest revision only)?
criteria.evidence: plist parses + launchctl label join; kestra latest revision; hermes state/disposition coherence.

criteria.prompt: Does the current platform match the canonical framework precedence given the job's evidenced shape?
criteria.evidence: route_job precedence result equals current platform (1), differs with full evidence (0), routing evidence absent (UNKNOWN).

criteria.prompt: Does the trigger shape fit the platform (resident resources on launchd, run-to-completion on Kestra, judgment on an agent coordinator)?
criteria.evidence: periodic run-to-completion on launchd (0), resident-with-evidence on launchd (1), scheduled deterministic on Kestra (1), agent-loop job (0.5 pending reasoning justification), none (UNKNOWN).

criteria.prompt: For launchd resident claims: is a held socket, watched directory, hardware, or sub-second resource evidenced?
criteria.evidence: WatchPaths/WatchSystemFiles/Sockets/NetworkEvents/IOKit keys (1); KeepAlive alone earns 0 for a claimed resident; not-claimed rows are UNKNOWN.

criteria.prompt: Is the job body class evidenced for D85 (CODE script path observed, or MODEL agent loop declared)?
criteria.evidence: existing script/ProgramArguments executable = CODE (1); declared agent loop without deterministic alternative recorded = MODEL (0.5); body not inspectable = UNKNOWN.

criteria.prompt: Is the lifecycle hygiene coherent (not retired/dead; enabled/paused intent recorded)?
criteria.evidence: active + enabled (1), paused/disabled with recorded intent (0.5), retired/dead/completed (0).

routing_sentence: Every job carries exactly two owners: a trigger owner (kestra | temporal | launchd | orca_pydantic | langgraph) that owns clock, retries, and concurrency, and an operation owner (code | model | effect) naming what runs inside; default kestra + code. Pydantic AI thinks only at justified MODEL steps with necessity claims; Temporal requires the complete five-field evidence block; launchd serves evidenced held resources; LangGraph is conditional graph machinery; Flowise is retained non-canonical — expiring, maps to kestra, never durable-admissible.

vendor_managed.note: Vendor installer surfaces own their launchd entries; migration is a vendor-contract decision, not an estate decision. Recommendation stays on the current platform with this reason.

proposal_seeds.name: Manufacturing ladder lead scoring
proposal_seeds.consumer: Darius GTM lane / manufacturing ladder owner (Mike)
proposal_seeds.mechanism: Score manufacturing prospects against the accepted opt-flagship ladder so the daily outreach batch draws from a ranked list
proposal_seeds.done_test: Scored-list artifact regenerates daily; top-10 batch exported to outreach staging with count >= 10; the export row is readable by the outreach job without manual paste

proposal_seeds.name: Pipeline health monitor
proposal_seeds.mechanism: Daily read of deals / qualified calls / offer paths against the 3/10/4 targets with a breach flag; feeds the kill-review discipline
proposal_seeds.done_test: Daily artifact names each metric vs target with breach flags; missing data renders UNKNOWN, never fabricated; one planted zero trips the breach flag

proposal_seeds.name: Proposal and follow-up engine
proposal_seeds.mechanism: Every logged qualified call gets a drafted follow-up and next-step proposal without manual reminder
proposal_seeds.done_test: A seeded call with no follow-up produces one drafted follow-up within 48h and a state transition; the seeded call with a follow-up produces none (no duplicates)

proposal_seeds.name: Client delivery tracker
proposal_seeds.consumer: First build client + Mike (<=2 engagements, <=40 founder-hours)
proposal_seeds.mechanism: Track delivery checklist state per engagement and measure Mike's founder-hours against the 40h ceiling
proposal_seeds.done_test: Checklist transitions are recorded per engagement; weekly founder-hour total is computed from recorded entries and alerts above 40

proposal_seeds.name: Fitness floor guard
proposal_seeds.mechanism: Detect scheduling conflicts with the protected daily training block and enforce the veto: a third weekly conflict reflows the RIG task, not the gym
proposal_seeds.done_test: A planted third conflict in a week raises the veto alert and names the task to reflow; two conflicts raise no veto

proposal_seeds.name: James affirmation nudge
proposal_seeds.mechanism: Daily concrete affirmation prompt with sent-state ledger; drafts only — sending stays Mike's act under Gate-D
proposal_seeds.done_test: One prompt artifact per day with a ledger row; a full rolling week with zero prompts raises the floor-breach alert; no artifact is ever auto-sent

proposal_seeds.name: Learning digest (corpus -> distillate)
proposal_seeds.mechanism: Weekly distillate cut from the polymath corpus, tracking per-domain silence so learning never zeroes in a rolling week
proposal_seeds.done_test: Weekly distillate file exists with cited corpus sources; a domain silent 7 days is named; the zero-week case raises the JAKE_DIRECTION 5 veto

proposal_seeds.name: Overcommitment detector
proposal_seeds.mechanism: Count open loops and parallel missions against the known overcommitment pattern and alert at the soft ceiling before the tilt
proposal_seeds.done_test: A planted 26th open loop raises the soft-ceiling alert naming the loop; removal clears it; hard-40 case names the escalation rule
proposal_seeds.suggested_platform: Kestra (deterministic counter) + Orca only for judgment triage

proposal_seeds.name: Weekly TELOS review
proposal_seeds.mechanism: Weekly current-vs-ideal diff written to the TELOS loop so the gap line stays in every greeting until the kill review
proposal_seeds.done_test: Weekly diff artifact names every unchanged gap line; skipping a week raises a cadence breach; Dec 6 kill-review inputs are assembled by the same artifact

disposition_rules: PROPOSED: rows in the proposals array only; never counted as live.
RETIRE: authority state is retired/dead/disabled, or explicit lack of consumer with coverage >= 0.6; uncertain rows never retire.
MIGRATE: route_job names one target platform with full precedence evidence and the target differs from the current platform; never vendor-managed.
KEEP: no migration recommendation, authority state coherent, and either a recent execution or a vendor/consumer contract evidenced.
INVESTIGATE: everything else; uncertainty is a state, not a score.
